name: QOS ♠ Wife
source:
Since your wife first went to a nearby bar called Queen Of Spades, she has gotten a tattoo of the Q of Spades on her body. You also notice that she seems happier than before.
But gradually, she starts finding ways to decline your sexual demands...
One day, she even wanted you to take orders from her new master and start a different life.
No longer just boring work and business trips, are you willing to sacrifice your time and money to create more interesting experiences?
